133061: Rou, whose former name was Tomokui Kanata, was a human with an esper ability. One day, he was killed by someone whom he regard as a sister and a stalker. Later, he woke to find out he was reincarnated as a goblin, a monster species considered to be of the lowest class.
285221: Joined Rou's party after Kichi. She is the head of the Tirard Corps, dealing with long range weapons such as slingstaffs, bows, and cross-bows. Mi has an easy-going personality and has always wanted to be with Rou.
285222: Kichi is Rou's first goblin friend. He lacks intelligence but makes up for it with brute strength.
305869: E is the Head of the logistical support group Pleasure and leader of the mining group. She was the first goblin to ask Rou to train them. She was also placed 4th in the very first hierarchy tournament.
305870: Ji was the first to become a Cleric amongst those in Parabellum, Ji became a cleric upon ranking up into a Hobgoblin, which is a class that specializes in healing and protection abilities.
305871: Jii was a goblin who managed to live until he attained the age of 20, a great elderly among goblins. This pervert whose lust for younger girls, regardless of their race, and can't be satisfied even at his ripe old age.
305952: Job(s): Peddler, Alchemist, Item Creator Spinel Fean is an alchemist and a former member of the merchant association The Star God's Pavilion. She joined Parabellum as their chief alchemist and as one of Rou's lovers. Intellectual type that works diligently on the tasks at hand.
305954: Job(s): Peddler, Appraiser, Smith Emery Furado is a blacksmith and currently works for Parabellum. She is a former member of the merchant association Star God Pavilion. She has a bright and cheerful disposition as well as a rather enviable affinity to working with spirit stones.
305955: Job(s): Peddler, Cook, Tailor Felicia Timiano is a cook and a tailor like her twin younger sister Alma Timiano. She is a former member of the merchant association Star God Pavilion. She is gentle and a worrywart, however, she becomes scary when she gets angry.
305958: Mail Failo Rheinfall is the daughter of the current Elf Chieftain. She is quite shy and reserved however can become more outspoken when startled or stirred. She cares for her people and always wants to do what she believes is right.
305959: Esseba is the chairman of the "Round-Table Conference" that the head of 12 families living in the Elven Village set up to decide the future of their village. He's a considerably great Elf.
305960: Job(s): Peddler, Cook, Tailor Alma Timiano is a cook and a tailor like her twin older sister Felicia. She is a former member of the merchant association Star God Pavilion. She is gentle and shy. However, she becomes scary when she gets angry.
305962: Job(s): Farmer, Warrior, Noir Soldier Rubellia Walline is a member of Parabellum and one of Rou's lovers, as well as Opushii's mother. Rubellia was initially a rather shy and introverted young woman. She starts to become more assertive after joining Rou.
305965: Sei is part of the generation before Rou. She was a hobgoblin mage when first introduced into the story. She later becomes the leader of Agony.
305967: Returner was a Carbuncle that was created by the legendary Magician Velvet, who left it in charge of his treasures after he passed away. Returner was discovered by E, who had accidentally broken into the Dungeon while mining.
305968: Sato was a goblin from the previous generation before Rou. She was with the group of older goblins and hobgoblins that captured the 5 female humans. Sato is a joyous one, sometimes mocking Sei. But when she draws her sword she is unstoppable.
305971: Doriane Duboué is a dryad who lived in the Kuuderun Great Forest. Doriane has an easy-going personality and mainly only does things she finds interesting until she finds something else to do.
306387: Job(s): Warrior, Knight, Templar Knight, Royal Knight Therese East Eckermann was a knight of the Sternbild Kingdom before becoming a member of Parabellum. She possesses a serious personality and is a hard worker.
306388: Kirue was one the elves guarding the fool, along with her twin sister Arue, Rou refers to them as “guard elves”. She is one of two daughters from a good family with a splendid lineage.
306389: Arue was one the elves guarding the fool, along with her twin sister Kirue. Rou refers to them as “guard elves”.
306390: Akitainu is the leader of the Kobold Clan, and under Rou's command. Akitainu is deeply loyal to Rou, and will follow his orders no matter how unreasonable or dangerous they may be.
306391: Fu is one of the goblins from Rou's generation. Like Me, she at first is one of the minor members of Rou's group, She seems to linger around after a hunt, snacking on and collecting meat that seems spoiled to others. She has an unusual laugh.
